items.headline: CoreWeave guides to ~$1.1B quarterly interest bill as debt reaches ~$47B, despite beat-and-raise
items.note: Interest burden is scaling with debt even as results beat, keeping neocloud debt-service coverage in focus; post-earnings bond reaction not yet confirmed.

items.headline: The AI 'credit card' is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
items.note: Five-year CDS reportedly above 1,289bp on Nov 5 (eased to ~1,155bp Nov 6) with bonds at distressed-level yields, signalling material market stress in neocloud credit.

items.headline: CoreWeave bonds hit new lows as Texas data centers in crosshairs
items.note: 2031 notes reportedly fell as low as ~79.5 cents on the dollar on data-center buildout policy risk, a concrete sign of stress in neocloud funding.
